license_required.quote: All persons commencing the practice of medicine or surgery in this State shall apply to the board for a license so to do.

issuing_authority.quote: the State Board of Medical Examiners, hereinafter in this chapter designated as the "board"

name.quote: the State Board of Medical Examiners, hereinafter in this chapter designated as the "board"

type.quote: said board shall consist of 12 graduates of schools of medicine or osteopathic medicine who shall possess the degree of M.D. or D.O. The number of osteopathic physicians on the board shall be a minimum of, but not limited to, two members. In addition the membership of said board shall comprise: one podiatric physician who does not possess a license to practice in any other health care profession regulated under Title 45 of the Revised Statutes; one physician assistant; one certified nurse midwife; and one licensed bio-analytical laboratory director

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Consumer Affairs, Department of Law and Public Safety
umbrella_agency.quote: the professional and occupational licensing boards located within the Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety

age_minimum.quote: satisfactory proof that he is more than 21 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: satisfactory proof that he is more than 21 years of age, of good moral character

degree_required.value: Medical degree (M.D. or equivalent) from a legally incorporated professional school or college
degree_required.quote: Prove to the board that the applicant has received (a) a diploma from some legally incorporated professional school or college of the United States, Canada or other foreign country, which school or college, in the opinion of the board, was in good standing at the time of the issuance of the diploma

accrediting_body.quote: a professional school or college shall be taken to mean a medical school or college or other school or college having purposes similar to a medical school or college

required.quote: the applicant, if he has graduated from a medical school after July 1, 2003, shall further prove to the board that, after receiving his diploma, he has completed and received academic credit for at least two years of post-graduate training in an accredited program and has signed a contract for a third year of post-graduate training in an accredited program

duration.value: at least two years completed plus contract for third year
duration.quote: completed and received academic credit for at least two years of post-graduate training in an accredited program and has signed a contract for a third year of post-graduate training in an accredited program

kind.quote: at least two years of post-graduate training in an accredited program

exams.name: State Board examination / USMLE or COMLEX-USA
exams.notes: Board may grant license without examination to those licensed in other states or certified by National Board of Medical Examiners or National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three attempts

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners
exams.notes: Acceptable in lieu of state examination for reciprocal licensure
exams.quote: Any applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery, upon proving that he has been examined and licensed by the examining and licensing board of another State of the United States or by the National Board of Medical Examiners or by certificates of the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons, may, in the discretion of the board of medical examiners of this State, be granted a license to practice medicine and surgery without further examination

interval_years.quote: All persons who are licensed to practice medicine and surgery shall be required on or before July 1 biennially to register on the form prescribed by the board

required.quote: the State Board of Medical Examiners shall require each person licensed as a physician, as a condition for biennial registration pursuant to section 1 of P.L.1971, c.236 (C.45:9-6.1), or as a podiatrist, as a condition for biennial registration pursuant to R.S.45:5-9, to complete a requisite number of credits of continuing medical education

period_years.quote: as a condition for biennial registration pursuant to section 1 of P.L.1971, c.236 (C.45:9-6.1)

value: prescription opioid drugs including responsible prescribing practices, alternatives to opioids, risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion (1 credit)
explicit and implicit bias for physicians providing perinatal care (1 credit)
topical_requirements.quote: include two credits of educational programs or topics related to end-of-life care ... include one credit of educational programs or topics concerning prescription opioid drugs ... include one credit of educational programs or topics concerning explicit and implicit bias

available.quote: Any applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery, upon proving that he has been examined and licensed by the examining and licensing board of another State of the United States or by the National Board of Medical Examiners ... may, in the discretion of the board of medical examiners of this State, be granted a license to practice medicine and surgery without further examination

requirements.value: Applicant must prove licensure in another state or certification by National Board of Medical Examiners or National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons, and must fulfill all other requirements (academic, age, character) applicable to examination applicants. License fee of $150 required.
requirements.quote: provided, such applicant shall furnish proof that he can fulfill the requirements demanded in the other sections of this article relating to applicants for admission by examination

exists.quote: The State Board of Medical Examiners, hereinafter in this chapter designated as the "board" shall consist of 21 members

national_certification.value: National Board of Medical Examiners; National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons
national_certification.quote: examined and licensed by the examining and licensing board of another State of the United States or by the National Board of Medical Examiners or by certificates of the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons

national_association.value: American Board of Medical Specialties; American Osteopathic Association; Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education
national_association.quote: at least two years of that training are in the same field or would, when considered together, be credited toward the criteria for certification by a single specialty board recognized by the American Board of Medical Specialties or the American Osteopathic Association or another certification entity with comparable standards that is acceptable to the board

regulatory_model.quote: Any person commencing or continuing the practice of medicine and surgery in this State without first having obtained a license, as provided in this chapter or any supplement thereto ... shall be liable to a penalty

credential_type.quote: All persons commencing the practice of medicine or surgery in this State shall apply to the board for a license so to do.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person commencing or continuing the practice of medicine and surgery in this State without first having obtained a license, as provided in this chapter or any supplement thereto ... shall be liable to a penalty

title_protection.quote: Any person shall be regarded as practicing medicine and surgery, within the meaning of this chapter, who shall use the words or letters "Dr.", "doctor", "professor", "M. D.", or "M. B." in connection with his name, or any other title intending to imply or designate him as a practitioner of medicine or surgery

scope_protection.quote: Any person commencing or continuing the practice of medicine and surgery in this State without first having obtained a license, as provided in this chapter or any supplement thereto ... shall be liable to a penalty

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination, as the case may be, through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or engaged in acts constituting any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the regulated activity or is inconsistent with the public's health, safety, or welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board or is of a nature such that certification, registration or licensure of the person would be inconsistent with the public's health, safety, or welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had authority to engage in the regulated activity revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with the disciplinary grounds of this section
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any provision of insurance fraud prevention law or been adjudicated of such a violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of P.L.1983, c.320 (C.17:33A-1 et seq.) or any insurance fraud prevention law or act of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed or dispensed controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause, or where the practitioner knew or should have known the substances were to be used for unauthorized consumption or distribution
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has prescribed or dispensed controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause, or where the applicant or holder knew or should have known that the substances were to be used for unauthorized consumption or distribution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license is required, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person in performing such an act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physician fails to notify the board within 10 days of any action taken against the physician's medical license by any other state licensing board or action affecting privileges at an out-of-state institution
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A physician licensed by the State Board of Medical Examiners, or a physician who is an applicant for a license from the State Board of Medical Examiners, shall notify the board within 10 days of: (1) any action taken against the physician's medical license by any other state licensing board or any action affecting the physician's privileges to practice medicine by any out-of-State hospital, health care facility, health maintenance organization or other employer

disciplinary_grounds.description: A physician who maintains a professional medical practice with responsibility for patient care fails to maintain required medical malpractice liability insurance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A physician who maintains a professional medical practice in this State and has responsibility for patient care is required to be covered by medical malpractice liability insurance issued by a carrier authorized to write medical malpractice liability insurance policies in this State

insurance_required.quote: A physician who maintains a professional medical practice in this State and has responsibility for patient care is required to be covered by medical malpractice liability insurance issued by a carrier authorized to write medical malpractice liability insurance policies in this State, in the sum of $1,000,000 per occurrence and $3,000,000 per policy year

definition_quote.value: the phrase 'the practice of medicine or surgery' and the phrase 'the practice of medicine and surgery' shall include the practice of any branch of medicine and/or surgery, and any method of treatment of human ailment, disease, pain, injury, deformity, mental or physical condition
definition_quote.quote: the phrase "the practice of medicine or surgery" and the phrase "the practice of medicine and surgery" shall include the practice of any branch of medicine and/or surgery, and any method of treatment of human ailment, disease, pain, injury, deformity, mental or physical condition

methods_authorized.quote: holds himself out as being able to diagnose, treat, operate or prescribe for any human disease, pain, injury, deformity or physical condition, or who shall either offer or undertake by any means or methods to diagnose, treat, operate or prescribe for any human disease, pain, injury, deformity or physical condition

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe Schedule II controlled dangerous substances in quantities not exceeding a 30-day supply, with authority to issue multiple prescriptions for up to a 90-day supply under certain conditions
drug_authority.quote: a physician licensed pursuant to chapter 9 of Title 45 of the Revised Statutes may prescribe a Schedule II controlled dangerous substance for the use of a patient in any quantity which does not exceed a 30-day supply

license_status_types.quote: Any person who desires to retire from the practice of medicine and surgery, and during retirement to refrain from practicing under the terms of his license, upon application to the executive director of the board, may be registered biennially, without the payment of any registration fee, as a retired physician.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Must present diploma from a legally incorporated professional school or college in good standing and prove 4 full school years of study; graduates of foreign schools must present proof of degree or full right to practice in that foreign country
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Prove to the board that the applicant has received (a) a diploma from some legally incorporated professional school or college of the United States, Canada or other foreign country, which school or college, in the opinion of the board, was in good standing at the time of the issuance of the diploma, or (b) a license conferring the full right to practice all of the branches of medicine and surgery in some foreign country

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: the applicant, if he has graduated from a medical school after July 1, 2003, shall further prove to the board that, after receiving his diploma, he has completed and received academic credit for at least two years of post-graduate training in an accredited program and has signed a contract for a third year of post-graduate training in an accredited program

pain_management_education_required.quote: include one credit of educational programs or topics concerning prescription opioid drugs, including responsible prescribing practices, alternatives to opioids for managing and treating pain, and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Initial prescriptions for acute pain limited to a 5-day supply; Schedule II controlled dangerous substances may be prescribed in quantities not exceeding a 30-day supply, with multiple prescriptions for up to 90-day supply allowed under specific conditions
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: a physician licensed pursuant to chapter 9 of Title 45 of the Revised Statutes may prescribe a Schedule II controlled dangerous substance for the use of a patient in any quantity which does not exceed a 30-day supply

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: A practitioner shall register to access prescription monitoring information upon initial application for, or renewal of, the practitioner's CDS registration.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Prescriptions via telemedicine must meet the same standard of care as in-person; Schedule II controlled dangerous substances may only be prescribed via telemedicine after an initial in-person examination, with subsequent in-person visits every three months
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The prescription of Schedule II controlled dangerous substances through the use of telemedicine or telehealth shall be authorized only after an initial in-person examination of the patient, as provided by regulation, and a subsequent in-person visit with the patient shall be required every three months for the duration of time that the patient is being prescribed the Schedule II controlled dangerous substance.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Any health care provider who uses telemedicine or engages in telehealth while providing health care services to a patient, shall: (1) be validly licensed, certified, or registered, pursuant to Title 45 of the Revised Statutes, to provide such services in the State of New Jersey

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The State of New Jersey enacts and enters into the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact with all other jurisdictions that legally join the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant shall be under the supervision of a physician at all times during which the physician assistant is working in an official capacity.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may order, prescribe, dispense, and administer medications and medical devices to the extent delegated by a supervising physician; may prescribe Schedule II-V controlled dangerous substances when authorized by supervising physician with certain conditions
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant may order, prescribe, dispense, and administer medications and medical devices and issue written instructions to registered qualifying patients for medical cannabis to the extent delegated by a supervising physician.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Notice from an insurer or insurance association or a practitioner, pursuant to section 2 of P.L.1983, c.247 (C.17:30D-17), regarding a medical malpractice claim settlement, judgment or arbitration award or a termination or denial of, or surcharge on, the medical malpractice liability insurance coverage of a practitioner

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Notice from a health care entity, provided through the Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety, pursuant to section 2 of P.L.2005,c.83 (C.26:2H-12.2b)

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The medical director also shall serve as the board's liaison to any licensed health care practitioner treatment program recognized by the board. The board, in conjunction with the medical director, shall establish standards for treatment and procedures for monitoring the progress of a participating practitioner's treatment

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If, upon review of the Attorney General's application, the board determines that, although no palpable demonstration of a clear and imminent danger has been made, the licensee's continued unrestricted practice pending plenary hearing may pose a risk to the public health, safety and welfare, the board may order the licensee to submit to medical or diagnostic testing and monitoring, or psychological evaluation, or an assessment of skills to determine whether the licensee can continue to practice with reasonable skill and safety.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A lawfully qualified physician or surgeon of another state taking charge temporarily, on written permission of the board, of the practice of a lawfully qualified physician or surgeon of this State during his absence from the State
